special_abilities.desc: A spellcaster who wears the guardian's amulet can cause the guardian to store one spell of level 4 or lower. To do so, the wearer must cast the spell on the guardian while within 5 feet of it. The spell has no effect but is stored within the guardian. Any previously stored spell is lost when a new spell is stored. The guardian can cast the spell stored with any parameters set by the original caster, requiring no spell components and using the caster's spellcasting ability. The stored spell is then lost.

Second Failure The target has the Paralyzed condition, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

srd-2024_skeleton.name: Skeleton
srd-2024_skeleton.languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 80/320 ft. 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The solar makes two Flying Sword attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Slaying Bow.

actions.name: Flying Sword
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +15, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft. 22 (4d6 + 8) Slashing damage plus 36 (8d8) Radiant damage. HitomThe sword magically returns to the solar's hand or hovers within 5 feet of the solar immediately after a ranged attack.

actions.name: Slaying Bow
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 21, one creature the solar can see within 600 feet. Failure: If the creature has 100 Hit Points or fewer, it dies. It otherwise takes 24 (4d8 + 6) Piercing damage plus 36 (8d8) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The solar casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 25):

- **At Will:** Detect Evil and Good
- **1/Day Each:** Commune, Control Weather, Dispel Evil and Good, Resurrection

bonus_actions.name: Divine Aid
bonus_actions.desc:
3/día.
The solar casts Cure Wounds (level 2 version), Lesser Restoration, or Remove Curse, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

legendary_actions.name: Blinding Gaze
legendary_actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 25, one creature the solar can see within 120 feet. Failure: The target has the Blinded condition for 1 minute. Failure or Success: The solar can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Radiant Teleport
legendary_actions.desc: The solar teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 25, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the solar at its destination space. Failure: 11 (2d10) Radiant damage. Success: Half damage.

special_abilities.name: Divine Awareness
special_abilities.desc: The solar knows if it hears a lie.

special_abilities.name: Exalted Restoration
special_abilities.desc: If the solar dies outside Mount Celestia, its body disappears, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in Mount Celestia.

special_abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
special_abilities.desc: If the solar fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The solar has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

srd-2024_specter.name: Specter
srd-2024_specter.languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can't speak
srd-2024_specter.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, its Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken.

special_abilities.name: Incorporeal Movement
special_abilities.desc: The specter can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

special_abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
special_abilities.desc: While in sunlight, the specter has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sphinx makes three Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. 14 (3d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Mind-Rending Roar
actions.desc:
Recarga: 5.
Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16, each enemy in a 300-foot Emanation originating from the sphinx. Failure: 35 (10d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Incapacitated condition until the start of the sphinx's next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The sphinx casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):

- **At Will:** Detect Magic, Identify, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation
- **1/Day Each:** Dispel Magic, Legend Lore, Locate Object, Plane Shift, Remove Curse, Tongues

legendary_actions.name: Arcane Prowl
legendary_actions.desc: The sphinx can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, and it makes one Claw attack.

legendary_actions.name: Weight of Years
legendary_actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the sphinx can see within 120 feet. Failure: The target gains 1 Exhaustion level. While the target has any Exhaustion levels, it appears 3d10 years older. Failure or Success: The sphinx can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

special_abilities.name: Inscrutable
special_abilities.desc: No magic can observe the sphinx remotely or detect its thoughts without its permission. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain its intentions or sincerity are made with Disadvantage.

special_abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
special_abilities.desc: If the sphinx fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sphinx makes two Claw attacks and uses Roar.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 5 ft. 20 (4d6 + 6) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Roar
actions.desc:
3/día.
The sphinx emits a magical roar. Whenever it roars, the roar has a different effect, as detailed below (the sequence resets when it takes a Long Rest): - First Roar: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 20, each enemy in a 500-foot Emanation originating from the sphinx. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition for 1 minute. - Second Roar: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 20, each enemy in a 500-foot Emanation originating from the sphinx. Failure: The target has the Paralyzed condition, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. - Third Roar: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20, each enemy in a 500-foot Emanation originating from the sphinx. Failure: 44 (8d10) Thunder damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:

- **At Will:** Detect Evil and Good, Thaumaturgy
- **1/Day Each:** Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, Greater Restoration, Heroes' Feast, Zone of Truth

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d4 + 3) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Radiant damage.

reactions.name: Burst of Ingenuity
reactions.desc:
2/día.
_Trigger:_ The sphinx or another creature within 30 feet makes an ability check or a saving throw. _Response:_ The sphinx adds 2 to the roll.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The sphinx has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 1 Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage.

special_abilities.name: Spider Climb
special_abilities.desc: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

special_abilities.name: Web Walker
special_abilities.desc: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the spider knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The naga makes three attacks, using Bite or Necrotic Ray in any combination.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Necrotic Ray
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 60 ft. 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The naga casts one of the following spells, requiring no Somatic or Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

- **At Will:** Detect Magic, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Water Breathing
- **2/Day Each:** Detect Thoughts, Dimension Door, Hold Person, Lightning Bolt

special_abilities.name: Fiendish Restoration
special_abilities.desc: If it dies, the naga returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its Hit Points. Only a Wish spell can prevent this trait from functioning.

actions.name: Needle Sword
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Enchanting Bow
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 40/160 ft. 1 Piercing damage, and the target has the Charmed condition until the start of the sprite's next turn.

actions.name: Heart Sight
actions.desc: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 10, one creature within 5 feet the sprite can see (Celestials, Fiends, and Undead automatically fail the save). Failure: The sprite knows the target's emotions and alignment.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.desc: The sprite casts Invisibility on itself, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 30/120 ft. 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

bonus_actions.name: Cunning Action
bonus_actions.desc: The spy takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. 2 (1d4) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Fire damage.

actions.name: Steam Breath
actions.desc:
Recarga: 6.
Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 5 (2d4) Fire damage, and the target's Speed decreases by 10 feet until the end of the mephit's next turn. Success: Half damage only. Failure or Success: Being underwater doesn't grant Resistance to this Fire damage.

special_abilities.name: Blurred Form
special_abilities.desc: Attack rolls against the mephit are made with Disadvantage unless the mephit has the Incapacitated condition.

special_abilities.name: Death Burst
special_abilities.desc: The mephit explodes when it dies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the mephit. Failure: 5 (2d4) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Proboscis
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage, and the stirge attaches to the target. While attached, the stirge can't make Proboscis attacks, and the target takes 5 (2d4) Necrotic damage at the start of each of the stirge's turns. The stirge can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can detach the stirge as an action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The giant makes two attacks, using Stone Club or Boulder in any combination.

actions.name: Stone Club
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 15 ft. 22 (3d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Boulder
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 60/240 ft. 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

reactions.name: Deflect Missile
reactions.desc:
Recarga: 5.
_Trigger:_ The giant is hit by a ranged attack roll and takes Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage from it. _Response:_ The giant reduces the damage it takes from the attack by 11 (1d10 + 6), and if that damage is reduced to 0, the giant can redirect some of the attack’s force. _Dexterity Saving Throw:_ DC 17, one creature the giant can see within 60 feet. Failure: 11 (1d10 + 6) Force damage.
